scope: Initial discovery/design work packages; future implementation split into child issues

items.title: Confirm prototype objectives and first-release boundary
items.objective: Translate the master direction into a bounded personal-prototype charter and measurable first-release design objective.
acceptance_criteria: Record Dean as prototype owner and distinguish company approvals from prototype choices.
Compare the planned-service starting point with any alternative Dean identifies; record the chosen rationale and explicit exclusions.
Define representative synthetic journey examples and the operational baseline questions that will need real evidence later.
Preserve GEN/SOL008 boundaries and update current status/decision records without rewriting issued sources.

items.title: Establish MYOB and service ownership evidence
items.objective: Determine which records the ERP and prototype should own and prepare a supported integration/hand-off contract.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory available MYOB version, companies, modules and approved non-production access; mark missing evidence explicitly.
Compare ERP-owned versus platform-owned service orders/appointments/time with one writable authority per field family.
Define the minimum read/manual path and candidate commands, keys, idempotency, unknown outcomes and reconciliation.
Produce a feasibility plan using synthetic examples; do not perform live ERP writes or imply the endpoints are verified.

items.title: Specify customer, site, asset and history contracts
items.objective: Develop DAT-01–DAT-03 and shared identity rules into a reviewable dictionary suitable for the first service prototype.
acceptance_criteria: Define stable IDs, ERP company/entity keys, required-by-stage fields, types and valid unknown states.
Distinguish legal account, group, operator, contact, site, facility and asset with effective-dated relationships.
Specify merge/correction, serial uncertainty, replacement/movement and historic report context.
Create synthetic same-name/wrong-company and multi-visit examples linked to AT-02/AT-30.

items.title: Prepare BP-02 architecture options and recommendation
items.objective: Choose a justified architecture for the private prototype and document a credible path to later operational use.
acceptance_criteria: Compare suitable runtime/data/hosting options against maintainability, cost, skills, offline behaviour and integration needs.
Document boundaries for modules, data, identity, documents, integration workers and recovery.
Separate prototype assumptions from tenant-specific facts and future production controls.
Record selected choices in ADRs and define the first implementation slice; no hosting purchase or deployment is required by this issue.

items.title: Prepare BP-07 planned-service workflow specification
items.objective: Specify the complete service journey that resolves missing job packs, difficult scheduling and missing technician context.
acceptance_criteria: Define screens, components, field/choice dictionary, role/state actions, validation messages and normal/refusal/recovery paths for A1–A7.
Elaborate TR-01–TR-16 with exact pack/report revisions, acknowledgements, concurrency, returned work and case/order/visit separation.
Specify drag/drop and keyboard scheduling, readiness, skills/travel, changes and customer communication outcomes.
Include time/parts review, report reservations, owned follow-up and Finance handoff; trace the selected scope to executable acceptance cases.

items.title: Define the minimum Finance handoff and trusted account view
items.objective: Make first-release financial processing explicit and reconcilable while retaining MYOB authority.
acceptance_criteria: Specify FD-10 manual queue as a viable baseline or a supported API alternative, with roles, statuses, returned ERP IDs and line mapping.
Define approved/billable/captured/posting distinctions, quantity reuse prevention and correction/reversal paths.
Select any FD-01–FD-04 account information required for the prototype; record grain, currency, tax, cutoff and source completeness.
Keep unresolved definitions and tolerances open; prepare synthetic partial-payment/credit/unknown-outcome cases for AT-31.

items.title: Specify controlled documents and first-release outputs
items.objective: Define document references and exact issue evidence for job packs, reports and supporting information.
acceptance_criteria: Specify DAT-11, repository identifiers, authorised file scope and exact issued-version preservation.
Design OUT-09/OUT-10/OUT-14 and selected technical/notification records with audience and required content.
Separate generated, approved, issued, sent, delivered and acknowledged events; include material amendment and offline old-version handling.
Identify actual SharePoint/template/retention facts still needed; use synthetic content and AT-20/AT-36 fixtures.

items.title: Baseline permissions, offline scope and operational targets
items.objective: Turn the proposed permission, mobile and recovery controls into testable constraints for the first prototype.
acceptance_criteria: Define actor/action/record permissions, restricted financial fields and server-side access checks.
Select representative device/connectivity assumptions and scope cached jobs, attachments, expiry and local durability.
Specify reassignment/revocation while disconnected, version conflicts, attachment retries and preserved captured evidence.
Define measurable performance/accessibility/recovery test conditions; preserve unapproved numeric targets as candidates and link AT-10/AT-11/AT-22/AT-23/AT-34.

items.title: Complete account-specific CRM parity and BP-03 scope
items.objective: Turn PAR-01–PAR-18 into a complete required-outcome and migration inventory for Powerplants CRM.
acceptance_criteria: Assess actual pipeline, separate lead/deal use, fields, activities, communications, automation, mobile sales and reporting.
Inspect licensed/used add-ons and integrations where access permits; distinguish unverified use from unnecessary functionality.
Define group/account/site/stakeholder relationships, next actions, renewal and aftercare outcomes.
Record preserve/improve/integrate/defer dispositions and source/history mapping with AT-25 evidence needs; no CRM mutation or cutover by this issue.
items.status: In progress - bounded discovery/design; account parity and acceptance open
items.design_contribution: BP-03 r01, PAR-01–PAR-18 evidence assessment, shared integration/coexistence, synthetic screens, acceptance and ordered CRM sequence; no runtime implementation

items.title: Prepare CREMS rule evidence and BP-04 reconstruction scope
items.objective: Preserve essential CREMS outcomes and resolve the hidden-rule risks before estimating replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Validate CRE-01–CRE-26 against controlled guide/solution/configuration sources and record each disposition.
Obtain or explicitly mark missing Screen Systems formulas/ranges/parts mappings, questionnaire rules and pricing thresholds.
Specify route inheritance, option/revision locks, staged edits, landed costs, discount/include/print rules and exact quotation outputs.
Create accepted calculation/output fixtures for AT-04/AT-26–AT-28/AT-36 and define safe IF-01–IF-03 conversion recovery.

items.title: Define BP-05 engineering and technical-release scope
items.objective: Define the technical-control workflows and native CAD/document boundaries for the future engineering module.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory engineering requests, design basis, capacity, RFI/queries, submittals, calculation reviews and interfaces.
Separate Engineering technical approval from PM gate coordination and record authority evidence still needed.
Specify material release/substitution, change impact, commissioning criteria, as-built and service handover.
Record CAD product/file relationship/storage constraints and AT-15/AT-37 evidence needs; no CAD relocation or authoring replacement implied.

items.title: Define BP-06 project controls and Smartsheet transition
items.objective: Preserve useful Smartsheet work and specify proportionate delivery/commercial controls.
acceptance_criteria: Validate selected MIG assets and classify template, synthetic, historical and operational records.
Specify native FS/SS dependencies, calendar/baseline/forecast rules and stable source mappings rather than importing legacy text alone.
Define contract obligations, variations, subcontractor coordination, RAID, tests/defects, staged acceptance and closeout.
Preserve Service control of confirmed bookings and plan AT-09/AT-32/AT-38; do not migrate or modify live Smartsheet records under this issue.

items.title: Define BP-08 material readiness and supply-chain interfaces
items.objective: Specify demand, purchasing, receipt, logistics and return coordination without introducing a second stock master.
acceptance_criteria: Map IF-11–IF-16 business entities, source keys, directions and read/manual/command methods.
Distinguish promised, ordered, received, quarantined, usable, allocated, shipped, delivered and accepted quantities.
Define line-level partial/reversed outcomes, shortage/readiness impacts and return/claim/credit separation.
Prepare AT-16/AT-29 evidence contracts and a minimum manual/read readiness path for Wave A.

items.title: Prepare synthetic pilot scenarios and acceptance coverage
items.objective: Translate the planned acceptance catalogue into a bounded and realistic prototype test pack.
acceptance_criteria: Define synthetic customer/site/assets, permitted actors, multiple visits, partial materials and report/Finance scenarios.
Expand selected AT cases into steps, independently specified expected results and evidence requirements.
Cover rescheduling concurrency, old pack offline, duplicate retries, unknown ERP outcomes and disputed/unavailable sign-off.
Separate documentation checks, synthetic prototype validation and future operational pilot acceptance; mark all unexecuted tests honestly.

items.title: Specify service agreements, recurrence and asset lifecycle
items.objective: Expand SVC-12 into clear contracts for coverage, recurring maintenance, warranty, renewals and asset changes.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish agreement, installation, commissioning and warranty dates; define unknown/disputed coverage treatment.
Specify occurrence identity, recurrence/version changes, skip/defer/cancel and replay without duplicate generation.
Preserve asset replacement/movement/decommission history and affected future maintenance.
Define owned customer/technical follow-up and supplier recovery separately; prepare AT-19/AT-33 without inventing response guarantees.

items.title: Define prototype delivery, recovery and future operating handover
items.objective: Document the controls needed to move from a local/synthetic prototype to any later approved operating environment.
acceptance_criteria: Define environment separation, deployment identity, schema/offline compatibility and secret handling after stack selection.
Assess repository review/required-check capabilities and ownership recovery; do not assume protection or a paid plan exists.
Specify backup/restore, monitoring, queue ownership, support hours, costs and knowledge transfer.
Record migration/rollback boundaries and AT-22/AT-35 evidence; no deployment, subscription purchase or production pilot is authorised by creating this issue.
